title: 微软推出 Scout，一款受 OpenClaw 启发的个人助理
content: Microsoft Scout 在 Build 大会上推出，是一款新的 AI 助手，旨在将 OpenClaw 的强大功能和灵活性带入 Microsoft 365 系统。
original_title: Microsoft launches Scout, an OpenClaw-inspired personal assistant
original_content: Launched at Build, Microsoft Scout is a new AI assistant meant to bring the power and flexibility of OpenClaw into the Microsoft 365 system.

title: 由于新规定，出版商将能够选择退出人工智能搜索
content: 英国监管机构要求谷歌提供一种工具，允许网站发布者选择退出生成人工智能搜索功能。该选项将在英国进行测试，然后在全球范围内推广。
original_title: Publishers will be able to opt out of AI Search, thanks to new regulation
original_content: U.K. regulators are requiring Google offer a tool allowing website publishers to opt-out of generative AI search features. The option will be tested in the U.K. then rolled out globally.

title: 特朗普政府因人工智能监管而自相矛盾
content: 唐纳德·特朗普否决了一项监管人工智能的行政命令。现在，政府官员和人工智能高管正在试图弄清楚是否还有什么可以重新拼凑起来的。
original_title: The Trump Administration Is at War With Itself Over AI Regulation
original_content: Donald Trump killed an executive order to regulate AI. Now, administration officials and AI executives are trying to figure out if there’s anything left to piece back together.

title: 消息人士称，Lovable 与 Google Cloud 签署多年协议，将使用量提高 5 倍
content: Lovable 和 Google 签署了一项扩大的多年期协议，其中涉及将 Lovable 在 Google Cloud 上的足迹扩大 5 倍，并扩大了对 Anthropic Claude 的访问范围。
original_title: Lovable signs multiyear deal with Google Cloud to up usage 5x, source says
original_content: Lovable and Google signed an expanded multiyear deal that involves a 5x expansion of Lovable's footprint on Google Cloud, and expanded access to Anthropic Claude.
